title: Horizon FX account outreach notes
body:
Quick brain-dump on Horizon FX (Horizon Financial Exchange) — outbound / partnership angle. Personal scratch notes, not polished.

Context / why they matter
- Mid-size FX trading / payments platform focused on cross-border SMB payments in EMEA and APAC.
- Recent Series B (public filing mention Nov 2024) and aggressive product expansion into multi-currency receivables.
- Likely revenue > $50M ARR (estimate based on funding + headcount growth).
- Heavy emphasis on latency for pricing/quotes and compliance for KYC; wallets and reconciliations are a pain point.

Why Redwood can help (hypotheses)
- Price/latency for LLM-based FX price commentary / personalized email generation: reduce per-request cost via batching/caching and dedicated capacity.
- On-prem or VPC deployment option for compliance-sensitive components (KYC PII).
- Rollouts + fallback: can route low-risk generation to cheaper quantized models, fall back to higher-quality LLM for revenue-impacting tasks.
- Observability + cost breakdown useful for finance + engineering alignment on unit economics of LLM features.

Key stakeholders (building LinkedIn-style outreach map)
- Evan Brooks — CTO (platform + infra). probable decision influencer. LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/evan-brooks-tech (verify).
- Priya Menon — Head of ML / Data Science. Day-to-day owner for model selection and infra.
- Marco Silva — Head of Product (payments). cares about UX and risk.
- Rosa Martinez — Head of Compliance / Partnerships (listening for data residency concerns).
- Sales/Head of Growth — maybe target for business case (use-case ROI).

Signals from public sources (confirm before outreach)
- Job postings for "real-time pricing" and "latency optimization" posted Q3 2025. Good signal they care about inference performance.
- Blog post (June 2025) about scaling multi-currency rails — mentions automated messaging to customers (touchpoint for generative content).
- Tweet thread referencing difficulty tuning embeddings for reconciliation matching (possible embeddings use case).

Top use-case hooks to test in discovery
1) Pricing/quote microcopy + sentiment checks — generate quick localized copy for quotes (reduce manual translations).
2) Reconciliation assistance — embeddings for fuzzy matching of remittance info.
3) KYC triage + form-fill assistance in private deployment (PII must not leave customer VPC).
4) Multi-channel customer notifications — SMS/email chat summaries depending on region.
5) Internal analyst assistants — summarize trade blotters, flag anomalies.

Initial value metrics to pitch (numbers to make it concrete)
- 30–50% reduction in per-message cost through batching + cache + quantization (target for pilot).
- <200ms median inference for quote microcopy (SLO target).
- 90% reduction in manual reconciliation triage time for high-volume merchants (pilot goal).

Objections and quick rebuttals (scratchy)
- "We can't risk PII leaving our environment." => Redwood Private: VPC/on-prem with customer-managed KMS + audit logs. Emphasize audit trail and SOC-like controls. Offer short POC in VPC.
- "Cost — we already have raw GPUs / infra." => Redwood Optimize: show batching/quantization uplift on their workload. Run a quick token-cost audit; show unit economics vs internal build + SRE ops burden.
- "Quality regressions after optimization (quantize)" => Show rollouts and per-prompt evals + automatic fallback to full-precision model if quality drops. Offer to run their prompt set to validate.
- "Lock-in / migrations" => Explain model-agnostic runtime and ability to pin model versions; can export cache / evals.

Cold outreach drafts (A/B) — subject lines + short body (keep terse)
Subject A: "Quick idea to cut Horizon FX's LLM costs by 30%"
Hi {{first_name}},
I noticed Horizon FX recently pushed on real-time pricing and automated customer messages. We help infra-focused teams reduce LLM inference cost and hit tight latency SLOs without sacrificing quality — often 30%+ cost reduction with dedicated batching and policy-based routing.
If you're open, I can run a short, free demo using 2–3 of your sample prompts and show expected cost/latency uplift. 15 min?
— Anjali

Subject B: "VPC option for sensitive KYC workflows — Horizon FX"
Hi {{first_name}},
Quick note: Redwood offers a private deployment that keeps KYC model inference inside your VPC with customer key control and audit logs. If compliance or residency is blocking LLM pilots, worth a quick chat.
— Anjali

Follow-up cadence (sketch)
- Day 3: quick value-add email w/ one concrete stat + ask for 15 min.
- Day 7: one-pager PDF (internal playbook) showing how we handled a similar payments customer (anonymized).
- Day 14: LinkedIn connect + short note referencing event talk / blog post.

Call script (10–15 min discovery)
- 0–2 min: quick intros + reason for call
- 2–6 min: ask about current LLM usage / pain (who owns models, where hosted, biggest ops pain)
- 6–10 min: present 2 tailored win scenarios (cost reduction for quote gen; private KYC triage) with numbers
- 10–13 min: technical fit questions (expected QPS, max latency, data residency needs, who owns infra)
- 13–15 min: next steps (POC scope / sample prompts / data requirements)

Discovery questions to prioritize
- What are the top 3 LLM-driven features you care about in next 6 months?
- Current traffic: peak QPS for text-gen / embeddings? mean tokens per request?
- Do you host models internally or use a managed API? If internal, what infra (GPUs, k8s)?
- Any regulatory/regional constraints (EU data residency, APAC)?
- Who signs off on security for new infra?

POC proposal (sketch / one-liner for deck)
- 4-week pilot: (1) run 2–3 representative prompts through Redwood hosted/dedicated to measure latency & cost; (2) trial VPC inference for KYC route if needed; (3) provide per-prompt evals and rollback/rollout policy recommendations. Deliverables: cost/latency report, prompt-level quality metrics, recommended config for production.

Things to do before first outreach
- Verify stakeholder names + emails (Salesforce / LinkedIn).
- Grab 6 example prompts from public docs / marketing / UI screenshots (need real text to run pilot).
- Confirm any regulatory restrictions (ask legal for template NDA wording if PII).
- Run quick internal sim on average tokens to get a baseline cost estimate to include in outreach.

Notes / random fragments (keep)
- Potential channel partner angle: they resell payments + want to white-label AI notifications — could be a bundled Redwood + Horizon offering.
- Look up recent talk at Money20/20 (speaker list). Evan or Priya might have been on a panel.
- Consider offering a "no-invoice" pilot: Redwood covers pilot infra for 4 weeks if they share 1000 anonymized prompts.

Next steps (my personal todo)
- [ ] Finalize list of stakeholders & get emails (Liam)
- [ ] Draft one-pager case study for payments pilot (Samira)
- [ ] Run 3-sample prompt cost sim and attach numbers to outreach (Anjali)
- [ ] Slack intro to Solutions Eng (tag @mike-solutions) to prep POC template

End of notes.

(Keep this in users/ because it's a scratchpad — refine into an outbound sequence in shared_drives/go-to-market if we get traction.)
